candidates.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
Make long-running agents faster with message threads
What Google Cloud announced in AI this month
Long conversations and agent loops on the Messages API can now send smaller requests and get a lower time to first token with message threads, in beta with the message-threads-2026-08-12 beta header.
